title: 第18章 战劫焚心秤星浮沉第19章 轮回劫里叩因果
slug: 道骨仙锋谪世录第115章归一
content_zh:
一、战劫降临·血火烽烟
大胤三百一十年，立春寅时，中天棋盘「战劫」位突然迸裂：
-劫界裂隙：
裂缝中涌出青铜战车与骨甲骑兵，车轮碾压处生长出「战争锈菌」，所过之地草木皆成兵器。
萧素雪的测天丝在接触锈菌时瞬间碳化，琴弦崩断声如战鼓轰鸣。
-劫界法则：
战争锈菌会将情感转化为战斗力——恐惧越强，兵器越锋利；仇恨越深，盔甲越坚固。
云栖鹤隐的机关鹤吸入锈菌后，齿轮运转声竟化作战吼：「此劫以「战欲」为食，越抗拒，越强大。
楚轩行的预判：
他的虚影在裂缝前凝结，指尖划过战劫棋子：「战劫界的「胜负之道」，在于让敌人主动陷入战争循环。
吾等若以战止战，反而会强化劫力。
-沈墨卿的质疑：
惊鸿剑斩向锈菌，剑气却被反震为血雾：「那便坐视不管？百姓正在劫火中哀嚎！
-云栖鹤隐的调解：
他取出「止戈茶」冲泡，茶汤在锈菌上凝结成冰：「茶有文武之道——武茶破局，文茶攻心。
二、战劫双雄·权情博弈
战劫界主·破军：
一位身披血焰披风的巨人踏裂裂缝，手中巨斧刻满历代战死者的名字：「吾乃战劫界「破军」，此劫要让天下人明白——和平不过是战争的中场休息！
-权术派的异变：
部分弟子被锈菌侵蚀，瞳孔中浮现「破军」印记，竟用同门性命祭炼兵器：「杀一人而救百人，此乃权术真谛！

监秤人·百里鸿生的布局：
他的窥天车悬浮于战场上空，车顶「劫棋平衡」旗无风自动：「楚轩行，你可知战劫界真正的杀招？」
-真相揭露：
抛向空中的监秤人棋子炸开，露出内层刻着的「因果链」：「战劫界的「胜负之道」，是让你们在「保民」与「止战」间永远两难。
楚轩行的破局：
他捏碎「权」字棋子，以血为墨在虚空书写《止戈论》：「吾以权术推演战争——当所有可能的战损都被计算，战争便失去了意义。
-招式·权算·因果链：
文字化作锁链束缚破军，链头是「仁」字笔，链尾是「民」字玺，竟将战争锈菌反蚀为和平契约。
三、情感具现·七情破劫
content_en:
1. War disaster is coming·bloody fire and beacon smoke
In the 310th year of Dayin, at the beginning of Chunyin, the "War Tribulation" position on the Zhongtian chessboard suddenly burst apart:
-The rift in the world of calamity:
Bronze chariots and bone-armored cavalry surged out of the cracks, "war rust" grew where the wheels rolled, and the vegetation they passed became weapons.
Xiao Suxue's tencel was instantly carbonized when it came into contact with rust fungi, and the sound of the strings breaking was like the roar of war drums.
-The rules of tribulation:
War rust converts emotions into combat power - the stronger the fear, the sharper the weapons; the deeper the hatred, the stronger the armor.
After Yunqi Heyin's mechanism crane inhaled the rust fungus, the sound of the gears turning turned into a war cry: "This calamity feeds on the "desire for war". The more you resist, the stronger it becomes.
Chu Xuanying’s prediction:
His shadow condensed in front of the crack, and his fingertips traced the war chess pieces: "The "way to win and lose" in the war world is to make the enemy actively fall into a cycle of war.
If we end the war with war, we will intensify the calamity.
-Shen Moqing’s question:
The Jinghong Sword slashed at the rust fungus, but the sword energy was repulsed into blood mist: "Then just sit back and do nothing? The people are wailing in the fire of calamity!
-Yunqi Heyin’s mediation:
He took out "Zhi Ge Tea" and brewed it, and the tea soup condensed on the rust fungus and turned into ice: "Tea has the way of civility and martial arts - martial tea breaks the situation, and literary tea attacks the heart.
2. Two heroes in war and robbery·Game of power and emotion
The Lord of War Tribulation·Pojun:
A giant wearing a cloak of blood and flames stepped through the cracks, and the giant ax in his hand was engraved with the names of the war dead in the past: "I am the "Broken Army" of the war calamity world. This calamity will make the world understand that peace is just the intermission of war!"
-The changes in the Machiavellian faction:
Some disciples were corroded by rust fungus, and the mark of "Broken Army" appeared in their pupils. They even used the lives of their fellow disciples to refine weapons: "Killing one person and saving a hundred people, this is the true meaning of power!
The layout of scale supervisor Baili Hongsheng:
His sky-peeping car was suspended above the battlefield, and the "Jie Qi Balance" flag on the roof automatically said, "Chu Xuanxing, do you know the real killer move in the Zhan Jie world?"
-The truth revealed:
The scale monitor chess pieces thrown into the air exploded, revealing the "chain of cause and effect" engraved on the inner layer: "The "way to win and lose" in the war tribulation world is to keep you in a permanent dilemma between "protecting the people" and "stopping the war."
Chu Xuanying’s breakthrough:
He crushed the chess piece with the word "quan" and used blood as ink to write "Lun Zhige" in the void: "I use power to deduce war - when all possible battle losses have been calculated, war will lose its meaning.
-Moves·Calculation·Cause and Effect Chain:
The words turned into chains to bind the army. The head of the chain was the pen with the word "benevolence" and the end of the chain was the seal with the word "people". It turned the rust of war into a peace contract.
3. Emotional manifestation·Seven emotions break the tribulation
